Questions people ask

Do you work with customers all over Sri Lanka?

Yes. Our HQ is in Maharagama and we work with customers across all of Sri Lanka, from Jaffna to Galle and Kandy to Batticaloa. Most work happens remotely, with on-site visits where agreed.

Can it work in Sinhala, Tamil and English?

Yes. We design for Sinhala, Tamil and English users, so your customers and staff can use the system in the language they are most comfortable with.

Does it have to use AI?

No. We build both AI-powered and traditional non-AI systems, and only add AI where it genuinely adds value for your business.

How do we get started?

Tell us about your business and what you need through the contact form. We start with a focused conversation and, where it helps, a small prototype before building the full solution.
